title: Cooperation between artificial intelligence and endoscopists for diagnosing invasion depth of early gastric cancer
summary: Full Springer PDF: AI classifier and three expert endoscopists evaluated invasion depth; a 100-case second-institution test and cooperative decision method were reported. AI+endoscopist F1 was .776, exceeding AI alone .768 and endoscopist majority .662 in reported comparison. This is bounded diagnostic evaluation. The admission is restricted to this measured result and study setting; it is not evidence of deployment benefit. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
